main_issue: Whether and when Agent D may cook strong-smelling food (e.g. curry) in the shared kitchen; settled on Tuesdays and Thursdays after 8 p.m.

A-B.evidence: B backs A's ban request (T2), likes the fan idea (T18), and accepts 'after 8' (T24).

A-C.evidence: C agrees with A that any strong smell is a problem (T9) and accepts Tue/Thu after 8 (T27), though C objected to the weekend (T15) and to the fan (T19).

A-D.evidence: D questions the ban and says 'I can't just stop cooking it' (T4-T10). A moves from a full ban to Saturday and then after 8 p.m. (T11, T21), D accepts a limited slot (T12, T22), and D proposes Tue/Thu after 8 (T26).

B-C.evidence: Both complain about the smell (T2, T3) and both accept after 8 and then Tue/Thu (T24, T27); they never address each other directly.

B-D.evidence: B backs a ban (T2); D resists (T10) and then accepts after 8 (T22), which B says is fine (T24). They never speak to each other directly.

C-D.evidence: C backs the ban (T3, T9), D resists (T10). C raises the Mon/Wed/Fri laundry conflict (T25), D proposes Tue/Thu (T26), and C accepts (T27).
